title: Arriving by bus in Ternopil: why Hotel Passage is convenient
summary: A practical guide for guests who want a room close to Ternopil central bus station and simple check-in after travel.
body: Hotel «Passage» is positioned next to or very close to Ternopil central bus station, which makes it useful for guests arriving late, leaving early, or connecting through the city.
For the easiest arrival, call reception before your trip, confirm room availability, and keep the hotel address ready: Torgovytsia / Zhyvova Street 7.
The railway station and central area are listed at around 1.5 km, so guests can continue by taxi, public transport, or on foot depending on luggage and weather.
highlights: Good for transit and overnight stays

title: How to choose a room category at Hotel Passage
summary: Double, twin, triple and family room categories serve different travel needs, from solo transit to family stays.
body: Passage Hotel public listings include Standard Double attic, De luxe Double, Standard Double twin, Standard Triple attic, Family room Triple, and Family room Triple improved.
Couples and solo travelers usually start with the double options. Friends or colleagues often prefer the twin category with separate beds.
Families or three-person groups should ask reception about the triple and family categories, including exact bed setup, view and current availability.
highlights: Double, twin, triple and family options
Exact setup should be confirmed by phone

title: Planning a short business stay in Ternopil
summary: What to confirm before a practical work trip: reception hours, Wi-Fi, desk, parking and departure timing.
body: For a business stay, confirm the basics before arrival: room category, Wi-Fi, parking options, check-in time, and whether your room type includes a desk.
Hotel «Passage» is a practical choice when transport access matters, especially for guests moving between meetings and bus or rail connections.
Check-out is listed until 12:00, which gives guests a clear morning window before onward travel.
highlights: Wi-Fi and desk details are useful to confirm

title: Topilche, the center and transport links near the hotel
summary: A simple orientation note for guests who want to understand what is close to the hotel.
body: Public listings place Hotel «Passage» near the central bus station, with Ternopil railway station and central landmarks roughly 1.5 km away.
Hydropark Topilche is also mentioned nearby by public travel listings and can be a pleasant city walk when time allows.
Ask reception about the best route for current traffic, weather and your luggage situation.
highlights: Railway station and city center around 1.5 km by public listing notes
